roadmap.title: Part 1 - Kiryu in Nagasugai
roadmap.description: Play Kiryu's story chapters on Normal and decline every offer to drop to Easy. Clear the Taxi Driver side story races and missions, start Nagasugai substories, and use the early systems (Kamiyama Works, training, street fights, minigames).

roadmap.title: Part 2 - Saejima in Tsukimino
roadmap.description: Play Saejima's chapters. Complete the Hunter and Killer main missions and contract missions, clear Tsukimino substories, and finish the Winter Combat rounds.

roadmap.title: Part 3 - Haruka and Akiyama in Sotenbori
roadmap.description: Play the idol story: train Haruka and win the Princess League, complete the Dance Battle Stories, and handle Akiyama's substories and Launch Strike kills.

roadmap.title: Part 4 - Shinada in Kineicho
roadmap.description: Play Shinada's chapters, train batting with Coach Igarashi, clear The Cost of a Swing missions, and finish the Cochin Cup Classic and Meteor Tackle kills.

roadmap.title: Finale and 100% cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the finale, then mop up everything tracked by the Completion List: all substories and Amon, the hostess finale, training masters, revelations, Climax Heats, minigames, tourist spots and collectibles, Victory Road and the Coliseum.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough and remaining levels
roadmap.description: Start a Premium New Game+ on Legend and clear the story again, then finish all Ultimate Match battles and raise any character still below level 20. The Dream, Fulfilled unlocks once nothing else remains.

achievements.description: Acquire all achievements in the game.
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in Yakuza 5 Remastered.

steps.text: Earn the other 55 achievements; this one unlocks together with the final achievement you complete.

achievements.description: Visit Nagasugai for the first time.
achievements.summary: Walk out into Nagasugai for the first time after taking control of Kiryu.

steps.text: Finish the opening scenes, take control of Kiryu, and walk out of the building to the Nagasugai street.

achievements.description: Clear Part 1 of the story.
achievements.summary: Finish Part 1 of the story.

steps.text: Play through Kiryu's chapters in Nagasugai until Part 1 ends.

achievements.description: Clear Part 2 of the story.
achievements.summary: Finish Part 2 of the story.

steps.text: Play through Saejima's chapters in Tsukimino until Part 2 ends.

achievements.description: Akiyama and Haruka are reunited during Part 3 of the story.
achievements.summary: Reach the point in Part 3 where Akiyama and Haruka are reunited.

guide.context: This is a mid-Part 3 story milestone: it unlocks when Akiyama finds Haruka, before Part 3 ends and before Japan Dome Awaits.

steps.text: Play the first two chapters of Part 3 in Sotenbori until the scene where Akiyama finds Haruka.

achievements.description: Clear Part 3 of the story.
achievements.summary: Finish Part 3 of the story.

steps.text: Play through Haruka and Akiyama's chapters in Sotenbori until Part 3 ends.

achievements.description: Clear Part 4 of the story.
achievements.summary: Finish Part 4 of the story.

steps.text: Play through Shinada's chapters in Kineicho until Part 4 ends.

achievements.description: Clear the Finale.
achievements.summary: Finish the Finale and complete the main story.

steps.text: Play the Finale in Kamurocho through to the end credits.

achievements.description: Clear Legend Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear the story on Legend difficulty.

guide.context: Legend unlocks once the story has been cleared on any difficulty and can be played with all upgrades and items through Premium New Game+. On Legend you cannot retry after a Game Over, so save often and reload the previous save instead.

steps.text: From the main menu choose Premium New Game and set the difficulty to Legend.
Play the whole story again through to the end credits.

achievements.description: Clear all Ultimate Matches.
achievements.summary: Clear all 30 Ultimate Match battles.

guide.context: Ultimate Match is a separate mode of 30 battles with individual rules, such as clearing enemies inside a time limit or with a set technique. It becomes available after the main story has been finished once.

steps.text: Finish the main story once, then open the Ultimate Match mode.
Clear all 30 battles, repeating any attempt that fails its special condition.

achievements.description: Clear Normal Mode without changing difficulty to Easy.
achievements.summary: Reach the end of the story on Normal difficulty without ever switching to Easy.

guide.context: Losing the same fight several times makes the game offer to drop the difficulty to Easy. Accepting it voids this achievement on that save, so always decline and keep retrying.

steps.text: Start the story on Normal and decline every prompt that offers to lower the difficulty to Easy.
Clear the main story to the end credits without accepting an Easy downgrade.

achievements.description: Defeat the leader of the Devil Killers in Kiryu's side story.
achievements.summary: Break up the Devil Killers by winning the final race against their leader in Kiryu's Taxi Driver side story.

guide.context: The Devil Killers race is the last of the Taxi Driver race missions. The rest of the side story does not have to be finished first.

steps.text: Do the Taxi Driver race missions in order from the Nagasu Taxi Office.
Win the final race against the Devil Killers' leader to break up the gang.

achievements.description: Complete 10 taxi missions in Kiryu's side story.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 taxi missions in Kiryu's Taxi Driver side story.

guide.context: Taxi missions are the fares taken at the Nagasu Taxi Office and are separate from the highway race missions; they can be repeated until ten are done.

steps.text: From Chapter 2 evening onward, take fares at the Nagasu Taxi Office until ten taxi missions have been completed.

achievements.description: Defeat Yama-oroshi in Saejima's side story.
achievements.summary: Defeat the bear Yama-oroshi in Saejima's Hunter and Killer side story.

guide.context: Yama-oroshi is the final main mission. The Golden Rifle handed out late in the side story drops any animal in one hit if you want to save time on the mountain.

steps.text: Complete the Hunter and Killer main missions from the Tsukimino hunting village up to the final hunt.
Defeat the ancient bear Yama-oroshi in the final encounter.

achievements.description: Complete 5 contract missions in Saejima's side story.
achievements.summary: Complete 5 contract missions in Saejima's Hunter and Killer side story.

guide.context: Contract missions are hunting requests separate from the main Yama-oroshi mission chain, and more become available as main missions are finished.

steps.text: Take and clear hunting contract requests in Hunter and Killer until five are complete.

achievements.description: Play all job types in Haruka's side story.
achievements.summary: Play every job type in Haruka's Road to Fame side story.

guide.context: Jobs split into Story jobs (Princess League rounds, handshake events, concerts) and Free jobs, and more open up as the story and agency rank rise. Failing or losing a job still counts as playing it.

steps.text: In Haruka's Road to Fame side story, play each kind of job until every type has been done.

achievements.description: Win against T-Set in the Princess League Finals.
achievements.summary: Win the Princess League finale for Haruka by beating T-Set.

guide.context: This is the final round of Haruka's Princess League and a one-time story segment in Part 3. Raise Haruka's Singing, Appeal, and Performance through lessons, jobs, and dance battles beforehand so the win is comfortable.

steps.text: During Part 3, reach the Princess League Finals and win the final round against T-Set.

achievements.description: Settle things with Akari at the Dance Battle Summit.
achievements.summary: Win the final Dance Battle against Akari at the Dance Battle Summit.

guide.context: Dance Battle Story missions unlock as the main story advances; Akari is the last opponent and beating her ends the storyline.

steps.text: Clear Haruka's Dance Battle Story missions in Sotenbori as they appear.
Beat Akari in the final Dance Battle at the Dance Battle Summit.

achievements.description: Win the final showdown against Shirakawa in Shinada's side story.
achievements.summary: Beat Shirakawa in the final showdown of Shinada's The Cost of a Swing side story.

guide.context: Shirakawa is the last main mission at the Nagoya Batting Center. Training with Coach Igarashi first raises Shinada's batting stats and makes the duel much easier.

steps.text: Train batting with Coach Igarashi, then clear The Cost of a Swing main missions.
Win the final batting showdown against Shirakawa.

achievements.description: Complete 10 baseball sub-missions in Shinada's side story.
achievements.summary: Clear ten of the baseball sub-missions in Shinada's The Cost of a Swing side story.

guide.context: Sub-missions appear on the Batting Center bulletin board, and new ones unlock as earlier ones are cleared. Some allow only one attempt, so save before starting one.

steps.text: Speak to the batting center attendant and clear sub-missions from the bulletin board until ten are complete.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% on your Completion List.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% on the Completion List.

guide.context: The Completion List sits in the pause menu and combines every tracked activity: substories, side stories, food and drink, minigames, hostess clubs, tourist spots, city exploration pickups, training masters, revelations, heat actions, weapons, the Coliseum, Victory Road, and Ultimate Match. The achievement is reported to pop when you open your status screen inside a hideout at 100%. Quitting the idol life during the finale can make 100% impossible, and missing Haruka's Tetsuya food request can block Kiryu's The Perfect Seasoning substory.

steps.text: Open the Completion List in the pause menu and work through every category, using it to see what is still missing.
Reach 100% across all categories, then open the status screen inside a hideout to pop the achievement.

achievements.description: 10 substories complete or finished.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substory progress is shared across all five characters, so any mix of completed requests counts.

steps.text: Complete ten substories with any characters.

achievements.description: 30 substories complete or finished.
achievements.summary: Complete 30 substories.

guide.context: Substory progress is shared across all five characters, so any mix of completed requests counts.

steps.text: Complete thirty substories with any characters.

achievements.description: 50 substories complete or finished.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 substories.

guide.context: Substory progress is shared across all five characters, so any mix of completed requests counts.

steps.text: Complete fifty substories with any characters.

achievements.description: Defeat Amon.
achievements.summary: Complete every substory in the game, then defeat the Amon Clan.

guide.context: Amon only appears after every substory for every character is done. In the finale, go to New Serena and talk to the man in sunglasses; the fight is four consecutive matches, so give every character armor and healing first. The reward is the Amon Sunglasses.

steps.text: Complete all substories for Kiryu, Saejima, Akiyama, Shinada, and Haruka.
In the finale, return to New Serena and talk to the man in sunglasses as Kiryu to receive Jo Amon's letter.
Defeat all four Amon Clan members in a row.

achievements.description: Order food at all eateries.
achievements.summary: Order at least one item at every restaurant and bar in all five cities.

guide.context: Eateries show in orange on the city maps and each one is tracked under Food/Drink in the Completion List; the character who eats does not matter.

steps.text: At every restaurant and bar across Nagasugai, Tsukimino, Sotenbori, Kineicho, and Kamurocho, order at least one item until the Food/Drink list is complete.

achievements.description: Shoot a picture of at least 1 tourist spot in each city.
achievements.summary: Photograph at least one tourist spot in each of the five cities.

guide.context: A tourism promoter in each city hands over the camera and points at a nearby landmark; one photo per city is enough.

steps.text: Find the tourism promoter in each city: southwest Nagasugawa Street in Nagasugai, outside Don Quijote in Tsukimino, the west Bishamon Bridge in Sotenbori, south Kume Boulevard near Kamiyama Works in Kineicho, and Theater Square in Kamurocho.
At each promoter's marked spot, raise the camera and photograph the landmark.

achievements.description: Find a total of 100 pieces of garbage, map scraps, drawing tickets, and locker keys.
achievements.summary: Pick up 100 total garbage drops, map scraps, drawing tickets, or locker keys.

guide.context: Garbage spawns on Nagasugai streets and drawing tickets in Kineicho, while map scraps and locker keys are fixed pickups shown on the city maps. Pick up and open Sotenbori locker keys as Akiyama, not Haruka, because she cannot use most locker contents.

steps.text: Pick up shining collectibles from the streets: garbage, drawing tickets, map scraps, and locker keys.
Open the Sotenbori lockers as Akiyama rather than Haruka.

achievements.description: Take a hostess on an after-hours date for the first time.
achievements.summary: Go on an after-hours date with a hostess.

guide.context: Only one date is needed and the hostess does not have to reach a high rank. Each city has its own hostess, and you must visit that city's information booth before the club will let you in.

steps.text: Visit a city's information booth, then order a drink at the club and raise the hostess's love gauge through conversation.
When the option to ask her out appears, pick it and have her accept.

achievements.description: Finish the final cabaret club event.
achievements.summary: Raise all four city hostesses to S rank, send them to Club Elise, and complete the final toast in the finale.

guide.context: The four hostesses are Riku (Kiryu, Nagasugai), Kaguya (Saejima, Tsukimino), Honoka (Akiyama, Sotenbori), and Shion (Shinada, Kineicho); Hinata is Kiryu's extra Kamurocho hostess. Rank them up with the Gacha Drink and strong conversation answers, then in the finale send them to Akiyama's Club Elise; Kiryu's Hinata unlocks through the MEB information booth once Elise is running.

steps.text: Raise Riku, Kaguya, Honoka, and Shion to S rank through club visits.
In the finale, have each man visit his hostess's city and send her to Club Elise in Kamurocho; Akiyama starts it by visiting Elise and taking the call for more hostesses.
As Kiryu, use the MEB information booth in Kamurocho to unlock Hinata, then raise her to S rank.
Return to Club Elise as Akiyama to trigger the final toast.

achievements.description: Complete a training mission with each master.
achievements.summary: Complete one training mission with each of the nine masters.

guide.context: The nine masters are Tatsuya and Minamida (any character), Sosuke Komaki (Kiryu), Tendo (Saejima), Yoko (Haruka), Saigo (Akiyama), Igarashi and Ayanokoji (Shinada), and Sotaro Komaki (any character). None are missable; each appears through the story and is marked on the map with a person icon.

steps.text: Complete at least one training mission with each of the nine masters.

achievements.description: Raise all player characters to level 20.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu, Saejima, Akiyama, Shinada, and Haruka to level 20.

guide.context: A Premium New Game+ Legend run carries upgrades over and makes any missing levels quick to finish.

steps.text: Fight enemies and complete content until all five characters reach level 20.

achievements.description: Complete a Victory Road event for the first time.
achievements.summary: Clear one Victory Road event.

guide.context: Victory Road begins as random street fights. Fighters in a gi are the clearest tell; after enough wins a man in a fedora and glasses marks a Victory Road event on your map. Anyone except Haruka can take part.

steps.text: Win street fights until a man in a fedora and glasses appears and marks a Victory Road event on the map.
Go to the marked location and clear the Victory Road event.

achievements.description: Rank in the top 10 at the Coliseum for the first time.
achievements.summary: Rank in the top 10 of the Coliseum with any character.

guide.context: Victory Road qualifiers are won through random street fights in that character's city; only the Coliseum itself is in Kamurocho, and you must finish a qualifier to be admitted to its tournament.

steps.text: Complete a Victory Road qualifier with any character.
Keep winning Coliseum matches with that character until their ranking reaches the top 10.

achievements.description: Get Kamiyama Works to level 5.
achievements.summary: Upgrade Kamiyama Works to level 5.

guide.context: Kamiyama Works appears in the cities and is announced by email for each character. The four upgrades cost 50,000 yen in total.

steps.text: At any Kamiyama Works, choose the upgrade option until the workshop reaches level 5.

achievements.description: Complete all Revelations.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 17 revelations.

guide.context: Most characters have one cutscene revelation plus three weapon revelations, and Haruka has one, for 17 total. Reports differ on exactly which ones are required, so finishing both kinds is safest. The game can crash while weapon revelations are being done, so save often.

steps.text: Watch each character's cutscene revelation by approaching the scene and following the three button prompts.
steps.note: Kiryu: arguing couple by a car on Modern Street. Saejima: Inari on a snowball in the east of the Main Street Park after Snow Festival Performer. Haruka: Ulala on Iwao Bridge after Starbound. Akiyama: the okonomiyaki stand southeast of the district after Okonomiyaki Performer. Shinada: Pedro at the batting center after The Sweet Spot.

steps.text: Trigger each weapon revelation by finishing enemies with the proper object using heavy attacks.
steps.note: Kiryu: blue buckets, portable stoves, pliers. Saejima: blue buckets, potted plants, bicycle wheels. Akiyama: a whole bicycle, yellow beer crates, a bowling ball. Shinada: a blue wheeled cart, yellow beer crates, a table desk. The Coliseum Street Fight GP has most of these objects.

achievements.description: Win 100 fights against enemies in town.
achievements.summary: Win 100 street fights against enemies in town.

guide.context: Street fights are the random encounters around each city, and wins accumulate across all characters and towns.

steps.text: Win random street fights until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Trigger all Climax Heat variations for Kiryu, Saejima, Akiyama, and Shinada.
achievements.summary: Trigger every Climax Heat move for Kiryu, Saejima, Akiyama, and Shinada.

guide.context: Each man has one base Climax Heat and two learned from master training, for 12 total. They are performed by entering fighting stance and pressing the heavy attack when the red prompt appears, after the setup listed for each move.

steps.text: As Kiryu, use Essence of the Dragon King, then Essence of Drunken Thrust with alcohol in your system (Sosuke Komaki level 3), then Ultimate Essence at flashing-red health (Sosuke Komaki level 5).
As Saejima, use Tiger Essence of Shockwave, then Tiger Essence of Braining while grabbing an enemy (Tendo level 3), then Tiger Essence of Blitzing while Yellow Dragon Spirit charges (Tendo level 6).
As Akiyama, use Killer Kick Combo, then Meteor Strike after taunting an enemy (Saigo level 3), then Final Drive after a Launch Strike (Saigo level 6).

As Shinada, use My Essence of Dragging, then My Essence of Whirlwind with a pole weapon equipped (Ayanokoji level 2), then My Essence of Bashing Combo with a one-handed weapon equipped (Ayanokoji level 6).

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with Dragon Spirit.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with the final blow dealt during Kiryu's Dragon Spirit.

guide.context: Dragon Spirit is Kiryu's glowing red state, activated with R2/RT during Heat Mode. Only the killing blow has to land while it is active.

steps.text: Weaken groups first, then activate Dragon Spirit and finish enemies while glowing red until 50 kills accumulate.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with Tiger Puppetry.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with the final blow dealt during Saejima's Tiger Puppetry.

guide.context: Tiger Puppetry lets Saejima grab an enemy's legs in Heat Mode and swing them around. Only the killing blow has to land while the state is active.

steps.text: Weaken a crowd, then grab an enemy by the legs in Heat Mode and throw or slam them to finish enemies while glowing red until 50 kills accumulate.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with Launch Strike.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with the final blow dealt during Akiyama's Launch Strike.

guide.context: Launch Strike is learned from Saigo and is triggered by holding the heavy attack in Heat Mode. Only the killing blow has to land while it is active.

steps.text: Weaken enemies, then use Launch Strike or its air follow-up to finish them while glowing red until 50 kills accumulate.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with My Meteor Tackle.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with the final blow dealt during Shinada's My Meteor Tackle.

guide.context: My Meteor Tackle is used with a heavy attack after a Finishing Blow in Heat Mode and hits harder when it slams an enemy into a wall. Only the killing blow has to land while it is active.

steps.text: Weaken a crowd, then finish enemies with My Meteor Tackle while glowing red until 50 kills accumulate.

achievements.description: Play all minigames (excluding special contents).
achievements.summary: Play every minigame at least once, excluding special contents.

guide.context: The Completion List tracks each minigame, and any character can cover the list. Playing a full round counts, but quitting out does not.

steps.text: Check the Completion List to see which minigames are still unplayed.

Play one complete round of each, tracked in the Completion List: Baccarat, Blackjack, Bowling, Cho-han, Cee-lo, the Cochin Cup Classic, Comedy Team, Darts, the Driving Range, Gunrhein, Karaoke, Koi-koi, Mahjong, Oicho-kabu, Poker, Pool, PrintCircle, River Fishing, Roulette, Sea Fishing, Shogi, Taiko no Tatsujin, Tatsu-ya Noodles, UFO Catcher, Virtua Fighter 2, Winter Combat, Air Hockey, and both Batting Centers.
At Baccarat, keep enough chips for a second round so a loss does not end the visit before the attempt counts.

achievements.description: Play air hockey 3 times.
achievements.summary: Play Air Hockey three times.

guide.context: Air Hockey is played at the Kamurocho hot springs on Park Boulevard; wins and losses both count.

steps.text: Play three complete Air Hockey rounds at the Park Boulevard hot springs in Kamurocho.

achievements.description: Use a local PrintCircle frame in all cities.
achievements.summary: Use the local PrintCircle frame in all five cities.

guide.context: You must take a photo at each location with the local specialty frame: the city Club SEGAs, both Kamurocho Club SEGAs on Nakamichi Street and in Theater Square, and Northern Lanes in Tsukimino, whose booth is inside the bowling alley.

steps.text: Use the PrintCircle and take the local frame at all six booths: Club SEGA in Nagasugai, Sotenbori, and Kineicho, the two Kamurocho Club SEGAs on Nakamichi Street and in Theater Square, and Northern Lanes in Tsukimino.

achievements.description: Play Taiko No Tatsujin and Virtua Fighter 2 two times or more at Club SEGA.
achievements.summary: Play Taiko no Tatsujin twice and Virtua Fighter 2 twice.

guide.context: Both games are in the Club SEGAs. Leave the building and re-enter between plays or the count may not register.

steps.text: At a Club SEGA, play Taiko no Tatsujin twice and Virtua Fighter 2 twice, exiting the arcade between each round.

achievements.description: Catch 5 fish while river fishing.
achievements.summary: Catch five fish while river fishing.

guide.context: The catch has to succeed; casting alone does not count. River fishing spots are the west and east rivers in Nagasugai, the Hunting Village in Tsukimino, the Sotenbori canal, Mid Square south of the TV Tower in Kineicho, and the Kamurocho sewers and Purgatory.

steps.text: River fish at any city spot until five fish have been caught.

achievements.description: Play Tatsu-ya Noodles 3 times.
achievements.summary: Play Tatsu-ya Noodles three times as Kiryu.

guide.context: Only Kiryu can play it, and each attempt must run to completion rather than being quit out of. The stall is by the river in Nagasugai and is available in Chapter 2 at night.

steps.text: In Chapter 2 at night, use the right-most food stall by the Nagasugai river and finish three Tatsu-ya Noodles rounds.

achievements.description: Win the Winter Combat Battle Royale Beginner.
achievements.summary: Take first place in the Winter Combat Battle Royale Beginner.

guide.context: Winter Combat is in Tsukimino late in Saejima's part. Winning the first two rounds unlocks Battle Royale Beginner, and only that beginner bracket is required.

steps.text: Play Winter Combat in Tsukimino and win the first two rounds to unlock Battle Royale Beginner.
Win the Battle Royale Beginner bracket.

achievements.description: Play a routine in Comedy Team.
achievements.summary: Play a routine in Comedy Team.

guide.context: Comedy Team is a Haruka minigame unlocked through the Aspiring Comedians substory, and it takes three auditions to finish.

steps.text: For Haruka, clear the Aspiring Comedians substory to unlock Comedy Team.
Perform the three Comedy Team auditions.

achievements.description: Win the Cochin Cup Classic for the first time.
achievements.summary: Win the Cochin Cup Classic.

guide.context: Only Shinada can enter the race in Kineicho, and the game introduces it automatically on Honjincho's west side.

steps.text: From the west side of Honjincho, enter the Cochin Cup Classic and win a race.

achievements.description: Buy the Otaku decal.
achievements.summary: Buy the Otaku decal for Kiryu's taxi.

guide.context: The decal costs 9,000 taxi points and only appears at taxi level 25, so keep doing taxi missions and races to raise the level.

steps.text: Raise Kiryu's taxi level to 25 by completing taxi missions and races.
In the taxi customization menu, buy the Otaku decal for 9,000 points.

achievements.description: Send a total of 5 million yen to Morning Glory via ATM.
achievements.summary: Send a total of 5,000,000 yen to Morning Glory through an ATM.

guide.context: Deposits can be split across visits and must be made as Kiryu. If short on money, gamble a Zero Jewel at roulette, sell the platinum plates, save, donate, and then reload to keep the money.

steps.text: At any convenience-store ATM as Kiryu, send money to Morning Glory until the total reaches 5,000,000 yen.

achievements.description: Strike up a conversation with townspeople a total of 50 times.
achievements.summary: Strike up 50 conversations with townspeople.

guide.context: Shop owners and pedestrians both count, and progress builds across all characters and cities.

steps.text: Talk to shop owners and passersby around the cities until 50 conversations are logged.

achievements.description: Check the additional info for the first time when a tip appeared.
achievements.summary: Open the additional info for a tip for the first time.

guide.context: Press the on-screen prompt when a tip icon appears while exploring; this is a one-time action.

steps.text: When a tip marker appears on screen, press the button prompt to open its additional info.

achievements.description: Get hit by a regular car for the first time (excluding event scenes).
achievements.summary: Get hit by a regular car in town.

guide.context: Scripted event collisions do not count, and cars break quickly, so use a busy street. Nagasugai is the easiest city for this.

steps.text: Stand at the roadside in Nagasugai and walk into the side of a passing car as it goes by.
